subject.name: Otto Roth
subject.historical_role: Hungarian and Romanian lawyer, journalist, trade unionist, and Social Democratic politician from the Banat
subject.event_role: IW-024 Banat (AXX) regional leader candidate for an alternate 1936 package
subject.regional_connection: Born in Nagy-Mutnik (now Mâtnicu Mare, Romania), moved to Temes County in 1907, served as a Temesvár municipal councillor, and led the Banat Republic as Commissioner-in-Chief from 31 October 1918 to 17 January 1919.
